_meta.name: Parent Observation: Mirror Items
_meta.respondent: parent_1 or parent_2, each completes separately
_meta.purpose: Each item mirrors a student item or construct (field key.mirror_of or key.compare_with) so the agent can compare what the parent perceives with what the student reported or scored.
_meta.scoring: Parent perceived construct = mean of its mirrored items (reverse respected), scaled 0 to 100. Compare with the student's construct using within-person z-scores (see agent prompt, step 2). Never feed these into Final_c.
_meta.privacy: One parent's raw answers are never shown to the other parent or to the student without recorded consent.
